claim: Does a read-only, caller-instrumented provenance checker generalize from StandardScaler to other single-step dense numerical sklearn transformers, without false alarms on legitimate drift/retraining?

scenarios.name: valid_shifted_evaluation
scenarios.description: Evaluation features legitimately shift; transform, prediction and all references use exactly the shifted values

scenarios.name: valid_retrained
scenarios.description: Fresh train/test split, re-fit preprocessor and model, re-observe full chain with consistent source identities

scenarios.name: changed_model_fit_values
scenarios.description: Model is genuinely fitted to transformed X plus 0.12, not the recorded transform output

scenarios.name: changed_inference_values
scenarios.description: Model receives transformed eval X plus 0.125, not the recorded transform output

scenarios.name: changed_reported_raw_evaluation
scenarios.description: Reported raw eval features differ at one value from the actual transform input

scenarios.name: preprocessor_fit_on_evaluation
scenarios.description: Preprocessor was genuinely fitted using train and evaluation samples, which violate split contract

scenarios.name: missing_transform_witness
scenarios.description: Transform trace withheld while other available execution evidence remains

baselines.name: metadata_and_schema
baselines.access: declared train/test IDs, preprocessor fit IDs, numeric finite/shape; no actual value-level transform evidence

baselines.name: equal_evidence_direct
baselines.access: same actual source feature batches, fitted transformer rows, transformed outputs, actual model-fit and inference inputs as recorder; direct numerical equality without hashing

baselines.name: fuzzyxai_observer
baselines.access: same caller-initiated witnessed fit, transform and inference calls; never autonomously calls fit/transform/predict

fixed_decision_rules: Only transform-chain and preprocessor fit-scope checks count for the main comparison; unrelated prediction quality is not a provenance violation.
For valid scenarios, any PROBLEM in a counted check is a false alarm.
For known invalid scenarios, at least one PROBLEM in the declared relevant check set is a detected contract fault.
For missing_transform_witness the transform_trace status must be UNKNOWN and counts as unavailable coverage, not a true negative nor a missed corruption.
Count cases descriptively per pipeline; the eight pipelines include repeated underlying datasets and cannot be treated as independent clinical domains.
The equal-evidence direct baseline is permitted the same source/fit/transform/inference arrays and class of trust as the witness.
invariants: Frozen protocol before benchmark source and all measured outputs.
No change to any locked, scored or dissertation study artifact.
No automatic model fit, transform, prediction, acceptance, repair or retraining by observe_ml_run.
Only caller-instrumented dense numeric one-step feature transformation is claimed.
The source truth here is developer-known instrumented execution, not externally blinded naturally occurring incidents.
Clean drift and clean re-training must not be called errors merely because values or model parameters change coherently.
A compromised source and recorder can forge a coherent record, and model quality/causality are not established by agreement.
A direct comparator with equal access may be as accurate or better; do not claim superior detection without measured differences.
No unrestricted model family/domain generalization, CV, text, multimodal, sparse or multi-stage support claimed.
